n_described_source: paper states 9,700 spp. = ~92% of extant species; described-species count not taken from this source
method_evidence: Every species' density is predicted from eBird relative abundance (mean count per complete checklist) in 5-deg grid cells via a brms density~eBird-RA model trained on 724 spp. (PIF/BTO/BirdLife); 9,016 non-training spp. get density by multiple imputation (mice 2l.pmm) with eBird RA as main predictor plus body mass, colour, flock size (eBird-derived), IUCN status as auxiliaries; area = occupied eBird grid cells or BirdLife range. Training spp. also re-estimated through the eBird model.
citation: Callaghan CT, Nakagawa S, Cornwell WK (2021) Global abundance estimates for 9,700 bird species. PNAS 118(21):e2023170118
location_in_source: Abstract; main text ('~50 billion'; mean ~428 billion); Methods steps 1-5; Dataset S1 (= Zenodo Tables/all_species_summary_table.csv)
notes: N_est = sum of 9,700 species medians in Dataset S1 (computed by tierA; paper text: '~50 billion', median of ordered-summed distributions). N_lo/N_hi = sum of species 95% lower/upper CI columns (computed by tierA; equals quantiles of the paper's ordered/comonotonic sum only approximately) - NOT stated numerically in paper text. Robinson et al. 2022 read total interval from Fig. 2 as 3.9 to 2,080 billion. Per-species 95% CI present for all 9,700. 5 species have median 0. Contested: Robinson et al. 2022 PNAS 119:e2113862119 (81% of 2,423 spp. outside BirdLife min-max); reply Callaghan et al. 2022 PNAS 119:e2117920119. Body mass enters imputation as auxiliary predictor -> partial allometric component (see tierA.md).

method_evidence: results_by_method.csv: 'Population reports' 393 spp. vs 'Inferred using SVR' 4,413 spp.; SVR feature table (all_included_features_RMSE_table.csv) uses range, body_mass, trophic_level, red_list_status, order -> inferred part is allometry/trait-derived; reported part from IUCN/other population reports.
citation: Greenspoon L, Krieger E, Sender R, et al. (2023) The global biomass of wild mammals. PNAS (DOI checked via Europe PMC)
location_in_source: gitlab milo-lab-public mammal_biomass: results/wild_land_mammal_biomass_inluding_populations.csv (4,795 rows; columns estimated_population, _2pt5, _97pt5)
notes: Availability only; detailed provenance is the Greenspoon agent's responsibility. N_est = sum of estimated_population over 4,795 rows computed by tierA, not a figure reported in the paper; total interval not summed (aggregation rule for per-species 2.5/97.5% not checked). 393+4,413=4,806 != 4,795 rows - unexplained. Species-level 2.5/97.5% bounds exist.
